dict.string: One Space indexes folders you choose in Documents so you can search those files on this Mac. Indexing reads the files you pick and keeps them on this Mac.
One Space indexes folders you choose on the Desktop so you can search those files on this Mac. Indexing reads the files you pick and keeps them on this Mac.
